method: Each milestone's consideration = coin quantity * unit fair value (0.0033 USD/CC). 2,000,000 * 0.0033 = 6,600; 6,000,000 * 0.0033 = 19,800; 2,000,000 * 0.0033 = 6,600. Total 10,000,000 CC * 0.0033 = 33,000 USD. Each amount is recognized only when its milestone is approved by the Accountability Committee and minted (measurement date = approval/mint date under the adopted judgment).
